login.introduction: `b`&[[LoGD]] Legend of the Green Dragon is a turn-based web game set in a world of fantasy.`n`nYour foremost goal is to slay the Green Dragon that threatens the village`n`nand make your name known throughout the land.`n`nYou begin with the turns granted at the start of play.`n`nA fixed span of real time makes one game day,`n`nand each game day grants you a set number of turns.`n`nYou play one of four characters — Troll, Elf, Human, Dwarf — each of a different temper,`n`nwith one of three specialties: Dark Arts, Mystical Powers, Thievery.`n`nShould a creature defeat you,`n`nyou may earn favor and be resurrected by fighting the undead in the graveyard.`n`nTo test your strength you may also duel other players in the Player Kill arena.`n`nThe rest is for you to discover in play.`0`b
